subject.title: Feature Request: Token Usage API for session_status Tool

question: Should `session_status` become the supported agent-facing structured token, cost, and quota API, or should OpenClaw expose a separate read-only usage tool?
rationale: Current main has several reusable structured sources, but choosing the permanent agent-facing API and its privacy, freshness, and provider-availability semantics requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Extend session_status
options.body: Add structured usage under `details` while retaining the rendered card and existing visibility checks.

options.title: Add separate usage tool
options.body: Keep `session_status` display-oriented and introduce a narrowly scoped read-only agent usage tool.

options.title: Keep gateway-only
options.body: Decline agent self-budgeting as a core contract and leave structured usage available only to gateway and UI clients.

recommendation.title: Extend session_status
recommendation.body: Add structured usage under `details` while retaining the rendered card and existing visibility checks.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored adjacent status usage behavior and has already reviewed the missing contract and its likely solution shape.
